tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i spyi don gyi snying po bsdus pa bzhugs/

gnyis pa lam shes bshad pa la gnyis/ rgyu mtshan dang*/ spyi don gyi sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed dang bcas pa bshad zin pa'i rjes su lam shes 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam mkhyain thob pa la lam shes rdzogs par nyams su len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir te/ 'grel pa las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rtogs pa ni lam shes pa nyid yongs su shes pa med na med pas lam shes pa nyid/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'dir lam shes 'chad na de mtshon byed kyi chos du zhig gi sgo nas 'chad pa yin zhe na/ yod de/ lus rnam gzhag tu/ mog mog por byed la sogs dang*/ zhes sogs kyis bshad pa ltar chos bcu gcig gi sgo nas gtan la 'bebs pa'i phyir/ bcu gcig po de rnams bsdu na gnyis su 'du ba yin te/ lam shes sgom pa po'i rten gyi gang zag dang*/ des lam shes sgom pa'i tshul gnyis su 'du ba'i phyir/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i khyad chos lnga yod de/ gegs mngon pa'i nga rgyal mngon 'gyur ba dang bral ba/ mthu chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa/ rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pa/ nyon mongs spangs bya'i gtso bor mi byed pa'i rang bzhin can yin pa/ gzhan don sgrub pa la 'bad cing yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byed pa'i dus dang dus ma yin pa la mkhas pa'i byed las dang lnga yod pa'i phyir ro/ /khyab pa dang*/ zhes pas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rang bzhin gnas (rigs )kyis khyab par bstan pa'i tshul gyis semasacan thams cad 'tshang rgya bar bstan pa la/ 'o na/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub par ston pa'i mdo dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal zhes 'chad pa la 'grel pa las/ theg pa gsum rnam par bzhag pa ni dgongs pa can/ zhes sogs gsungs/ 'di'i skabs su/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du 'dod pa'i lugs dgod pa/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu bsgrub pa/ 'khor ba la mtha' yod med dpyad pa/

nyan rang dgra bcom pa theg chen lam du 'jug pa'i tshe lam gang nas 'jug par dpyad pa dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ nyan thos sde gnyis dang lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa rnams kyis ni mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub par 'dod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bye brag smra pas/ nyan thos kyi sbyor lam drod rtse nas sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la 'jug pa yod/ drod rtse bzod pa gsum la gnas pa rang rgyal lam du 'jug pa yod kyang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi lam du 'jug pa mi 'dod/ nyan thos se 'da' ba kha cig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bkar mi 'dod cing*/ nyan thos kyi lhag med myang 'das kyi tshe bem rig rgyun chad par 'dod/ lung gi rjes 'brang gi sems tsam pa rnams kyis mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub par lung rigs gnyis kyis sgrub pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ yum gyi mdo las/ gang yang dag par skyon med pa la zhugs par gyur pa de dag la ni bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i mthu med do/ /zhes pa lta bu'i lung du ma dang*/ sems can rnams kyi rgyu la khams mi 'dra ba bden grub gsum dang*/ mos pa mi 'dra ba bden grub gsum dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub mi 'dra ba bden grub gsum 'byung ba'i rigs pa sogs kyis sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ 'o na/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu ston pa'i mdo dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel ba'i phyir/ dgongs bzhi yod de/ theg gsum gang zag gi rgyud kyi chos dbyings kyi ngo bo la rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med pa sogs rnam pa bdun la dgongs pa'i phyir/ dgos pa yod de/ theg dman du rigs ma nges kha cig theg chen du kha drangs pa dang*/ theg chen du rigs ma nges pa kha cig theg dman lam du mi ltung ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ dngos la gnod byed yod de/

mthar thug theg pa gsum du ston pa'i lung rigs rnams dang*/ gzhan dbang bden grub tu ston pa'i lung rigs rnams kyis kyang gnod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mthar thug theg pa gcig tu sgrub pa la lung dang rigs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu lung gis 'grub ste/ yum gyi mdo las/ 'on kyang de dag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na de dag la yang rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /zhes sogs dang*/ lang gshegs dang*/ dpal 'phreng gis zhus pa dang*/ dam chos pad dkar sogs kyi lung du mas 'grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa rigs pa'i sgrub byed yod de/ sems can gyi sems bden pas stong pas de thams cad kyi rgyud la rang bzhin gnas rigs kyis khyab pa dang*/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i gzhi rtsa bden 'dzin gyi rtsa ba mi brtan pas dri ma rnams gnyen pos spong rung yin pa sogs kyi rigs pas 'grub pa'i phyir/ mthar thug theg pa gsum du grub pa ston pa'i mdo dang mi 'gal te/ dgongs gzhi dgos pa dang dngos la gnod byed gsum gyi sgo nas drang don du 'grel ba'i phyir te/ dgongs gzhi ni gnas skabs theg pa gsum la dgongs/ dgongs pa des gdul ba'i ched dang*/ gnod byed ni sngar gyi lung rigs rnams kyis gnod pa'i phyir ro/ gsum pa 'khor ba la mtha' yod med dpyad pa la/ dogs dgod pa dang*/ de'i lan no/ /dang po la/ kha cig na re/ 'khor ba mtha' med de/ 'khor ba la thog ma'i mtha' med cing*/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang med pa'i phyir/ thog ma'i mtha' med de/ yod na sngon gtan nas ma byung pa'i sems can yod pa dang*/ sems can rgyu med par 'byung bar thal ba'i phyir/ phyi ma'i mtha' med de/ dus 'di tsa na sems can gcig kyang gtan nas med ces mtshams 'dzin mi nus pa'i phyir dang*/ gal te nus srid na'ang sangs rgyas phyi ma de dag gi don bya yul gyi sems can nyung ba'am gtan med du 'gyur ba'i phyir/

sems can gyi zad mtha' yang med de/ nam mkha'i khyon ci tsam yod pa de tsam du sems can gyis khyab pa'i phyir te/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/ sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin te/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zhe na/ gnyis pa lan ni/ sems can thams cad 'tshang rgya bar lung rigs kyis 'grub pas 'khor ba la mtha' yod par grub ste/ sems can thams cad nam sangs rgyas pa na 'khor ba gtan nas spangs pa'i 'khor ba la phyi mtha' yod par grub pa'i phyir dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'khor ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin gyi zhen yul sun phyung ba'i tshul gyis 'khor ba yang spong bar byed pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba la thog ma'i mtha' med kyang phyi mtha' yod pa mi 'gal te/ dper na/ sa bon sogs kyi thog mtha' med kyang*/ mes bsregs pa sogs kyis phyi mtha' yod par mthong ba'i phyir te/ sa paṇa gyis/ sa bon thog mtha' yod min yang*/ mes bsregs pa na phyi mtha' mthong*/ de bzhin 'khor ba thog med kyang*/ bdag med mthong na phyi mtha' mthong*/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'khor ba la phyi mtha' yod pas 'khor ba la mtha' yod pa'i go mi chod ces bzhed pa'ang yod do/ /bzhi pa nyan rang dgra bcom pa theg chen lam du 'jug pa'i tshe lam gang nas 'jug pa'i tshul yod de/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam nyid nas 'jug dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe byang chub tu sems bskyed dgos shing*/ tshogs sbyor gyi skabs su grangs med dang po'i ngo skal gyi tshogs gsog dgos pa dang*/ mthong lam gyi skabs su shes sgrib kun btags spong dgos pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ nyan rang dgra bcom theg chen gyi tshogs lam du zhugs pa'i tshogs lam pa de tshogs lam pa yin nam min zhe na/ kha cig de theg chen tshogs lam pa yin kyang tshogs lam pa min/ theg chen so skye yin kyang so skye min zhes gsungs/ de so skye min yang theg chen so skye dang tshogs lam par khas blangs par bya ste/

de ltar yin na de theg chen mthong lam du zhugs pa'i tshe mthong lam pa min pa dang*/ theg chen sgom lam du zhugs pa'i tshe sgom lam pa min zhes 'dod pa'i skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de 'dra'i tshogs lam pa de theg chen 'phags pa dang theg dman 'phags pa gang rung min yang 'phags pa yin te/ 'phags pa phung gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ de theg chen dang theg dman dgra bcom gang rung min yang dgra bcom yin te/ nyon mongs spangs pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen dgra bcom ma yin te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa min pa'i phyir/ theg dman dgra bcom min te/ theg chen pa yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni 'khor ba ji srid par 'gro ba'i don byed par zhugs pa nyid kyis nyon mongs pa zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ kha cig na re/ 'dir bshad pa'i nyon mongs de/ nyon mongs btags pa yin te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su 'tshol ba'i mi ngoms pa sogs brgyad po de la nyon mongs pa'i ming gis btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir zhes zer yang*/ de ni mi 'thad de/ skabs 'dir bstan pa'i nyon mongs de nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de byang chub sems dpas gzhan don sgrub pa la nye bar 'khor ba'i nyon mongs zhig la byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byang 'phags 'dod khams su 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal lta bur skye ba bzhes nas sras stong sogs skyed pa la ni 'dod pa'i 'dod chags gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur/ gzugs khams su skye ba blangs nas gzugs kyi 'dod chags kyis gzhan dga' bar byas pa sogs kyi sgo nas gzhan don grub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ des na 'dod pa dang gzugs kyi 'dod chags lta bu ni 'dir bstan pa'i nyon mongs yin te/ de gnyis byang chub sems dpas gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur bar byar yod cing*/ nyon mongs gzhan ma rig zhe sdang nga rgyal the tshom 'jig lta log lta sogs ni byang chub sems dpas don gnyis sgrub pa la nye mkho med pa'i phyir/

de ltar yin kyang 'dod gzugs kyi 'dod chags gzhan don sgrub pa'i yan lag tu sgyur ba de byang chub sems pa'i blang byar mdzad kyi/ 'dod gzugs kyi 'dod chags nyid blang byar mi mdzad de/ de byang chub sems dpa'i spang bya yin pa'i phyir/ de byang sems kyi spang bya yin pas spong par mdzad kyang spang bya'i gtso bor byas shing ched du gnyer nas mi spong ste/ 'grel chen las/ ma rig pa dang lta bas bsdus pa'i bag la nyal ni spong gi /'dod pa dang srid pa'i zag pa ni min te/ bsam bzhin du srid pa skye ba len pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar gsungs pa ni byang sems nyon mongs ma spangs pa dag gi dbang du mdzad pa yin gyi/ byang 'phags nyon mongs spangs pa dag snying rje dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'dod khams su skye ba blangs nas sras bskyed pa'i sgo nas gzhan don sgrub pa la ni nyon mongs grogs su mi dgos te/ de dag 'dod khams su skye ba blangs nas btsun mo dang sras bskyed pa'i 'grel pa ni 'phrul dang byin rlabs dang smon lam sogs kyis 'byung ba'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po don 'grub dang*/ srong btsan sgam po sogs bzhin no/ /lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ 'dir bstan shes bya'i lam ngos bzung nas de ji ltar shes par byed tshul dang*/ shes pa'i dgongs pa gang yin dang*/ lam shes kyi khyad par bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ mi rtag la sogs bcu drug mngon du rtogs pa'i ye shes de ni/ 'dir bstan shes bya'i nyan thos kyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ de byang sems kyis sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la bskyed nas shes par byed dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sbyor ba'i dus su sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi'i dus su bden par mi dmigs par rtogs pa'i shes rab/ rjes kyi skabs su rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i bsngo bas zin pa'i sgo nas rang gi blo ngor bskyed nas shes par bya dgos pa'i phyir te/

rtsa bar/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni/ zhes pas mi rtag sogs bcu drug mngon sum rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ bden med rtogs pa'i zin byed bcas dngos su bstan nas/ zin byed gzhan gnyis shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de ltar shes pa la dgos pa yod de/ nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ skyes bu 'bring dang thun mongs pa'i lam gyi rim pa'i blo spyong ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs 'dir dngos su bstan pa'i nyan thos kyi lam shes pa ni theg chen gyi mthong lam la byed kyang*/ spyir nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de de'i ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni/ zhes sogs kyis/ nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha 'thun zin byed dang bcas pa bstan pa yin te/ des mi rtag sogs bcu drug don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor lam bzhi de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun du bstan nas/ de bzhi stong nyid rtogs pa'i sbyor bzhis zin dgos par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ rang rgyal gyi rnam bzhag la/ spyir rang rgyal zhes pa ni srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma rten par rang gi byang chub mngon du byed pa dang byas pa'i theg pa 'bring po'i gang zag zhig la brjod cing*/ de la dbye na gsum yod de/ bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal/ tshogs spyod che chung gi rang rgyal gnyis dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de dag khyad chos bdun gyi sgo nas shes par bya ba yin te/ rigs dang dbang po'i khyad par/ de bzhin du lam bsgrod tshul/ tshogs gsog tshul/ 'bras bu thob tshul/ gnas pa dang rgyu tshul/

chos ston tshul/ sgra don dang bdun gyis shes par bya ba'i phyir/ de rnams bsdus te brjod na/ bdun gyi dang po yod de/ de dag 'du 'dzi la mi dga' zhing gcig pur gnas pa la dgyais/ gzhan don rgya chen po la mi dga' bar nang du yang dag 'jog la dga'/ phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong phyir du brtson pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal des skye ba gcig thogs man la bskal brgyar sangs rgyas yongs 'dzin du legs par bsten mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa byas nas smon lam chen po gsum btab/ skye ba phyi ma srid pa tha ma'i tshe sbyor lam drod yan chad rten thog gcig la sgrod par byed/ tshogs spyod chen po ba des skye ba gcig thogs man chad du sbyor lam bzod 'bring man la gnas nas sngar bzhin byas te/ skye ba phyi ma srid pa tha ma'i tshe sbyor lam bzod chen yan chad sngar ltar rten thog gcig la sgrod par byed/ tshogs spyod chung ngu ba des skye ba gcig thogs kyi tshe mthong lam man chad la gnas nas sngar bzhin byas te/ skye ba phyi ma'i tshe sgom lam yan chad rten thog gcig tu sgrod par byed phyir/ mkhas bya'i dngos po drug yod de/ phung po khams skye mched rten 'brel bden gnas dang gnas min la mkhas pa rnams yin pa'i phyir/ smon lam chen mo gsum yod de/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing du skye ba dang*/ srid pa tha ma'i tshe gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma bltos par byang chub mngon du byed nus pa dang*/ sgras ma brjod par gzhan la chos ston nus par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam gsum po de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ bse ru lta bu phal cher gyis bskal ba brgya dang*/ gzhan gnyis kyis bskal ba brgya'am de las mang ba'i bskal ba dag tu tshogs gsog par byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ gsum kas kyang srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma bltos par rang gi byang chub mngon du byed par mtshungs pa'i phyir/

lnga pa yod de/ gsum gas thugs kyi gnas pa rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs ldog dang*/ rnam thar sgo gsum la gnas/ sku'i gnas skabs bse ru lta bu gcig pur gnas pa dang*/ gzhan gnyis tshogs nang du gnas pa gtso che ba'i phyir/ gang du 'gro zhing rgyu ba'i khyad par yod de/ bsod snyoms sogs la rgyu ba'i tshe dbang po'i sgo bsdoms pa dang*/ rdzun 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa sogs kyi sgo nas rgyu ba'i phyir/ drug pa yod de/ ngag gi chos ston pa srid kyang gtso cher sgra med sprul bsgyur ya ma zung bstan pa'i sgo nas gzhan rgyud la lam gyi rtogs pa bskyed par byed pa'i phyir/ bdun pa yod de/ dang po de ri dwags bse ru ltar gcig pur gnas pa la dga' ba dang*/ gzhan gnyis grogs mang po dang lhan cig tu tshogs shing spyod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ ༈ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ 'dir bstan shes bya'i lam ngos bzung nas shes par byed tshul/ shes pa'i dgos pa/ de'i lam shes kyi khyad par dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan gyis stong pa'i stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de nyid/ 'dir bstan shes bya'i rang rgyal gyi lam yin pa'i phyir te/ de byang chub sems dpas sems bskyed bsngo ba bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud kyi blo ngor bskyed nas shes par bya ba'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de ltar shes pa la dgos pa yod de/ rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su 'dzin pa dang rang rgyud kyi phyi rol don 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong ba sogs kyi dgos pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skabs 'di'i dngos stan gyi rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes ni theg chen gyi mthong lam yin yang*/ spyir rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes 'jog tshul yod de/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs rigs su gnas pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa de/

de'i ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar/ zhes sogs kyis rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun zin byed dang bcas pa bstan pa yin te/ des gzugs sogs kyi phyi rol don gyis stong pa don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor gzhi po de/ de'i rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun du bstan nas de stong nyid rtogs pa'i sbyor lam bzhis zin dgos par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na byang sems kyis nyan rang gi lam shes rgyu dang bcas pa sgom tshul yod de/ des nyan rang gi byang chub tu bgrod pa'i lam gyi gtso bor ji lta bu yin pa de bzhin du shes par byas nas de dang mthun pa'i lam sgom pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su/ mthong lam gyi rten dang*/ brten pa mthong lam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gnyis yod de/ lus rten dang sems rten gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po lus rten yod de/ ngan song gsum dang*/ mtshams med stobs chen bsags pa dang*/ za ma dang ma ning dang sgra mi snyan pa dang gzugs dang gzugs med khams pa ma gtogs/ gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha'-i rten la gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ mthong lam skye ba'i rten la skyo shas che ba zhig dgos te/ khams gong ma'i rten la tshor ba sdug bsngal mngon 'gyur ba med pas skyo shas chung ba'i don gyis mthong lam gsar du mi skye ba'i phyir te/ mdzod las/ gong na mthong lam med mi skyo zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gong ma'i rten la gsar du skyes pa'i mthong lam ni yod de/ khams gong du skyes pa'i mthong lam pa yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa sems rten yod de/ spyir mthong lam ni bsam gtan sa drug la brten nas skye ba yod kyang*/ theg chen gyi mthong lam ni rab mtha'i bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi kho na la brten nas skye ba'i phyir/

nyis pa la mthong lam bshad pa la/ bye brag tu smra ba'i lugs dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mdzod las bshad pa ltar mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug po rim can kho nar skye ste/ dang por 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi mthong spang nyon mongs kyi dngos gnyen sdug bsngal chos bzod dang*/ de nas des drangs pa'i chos shes/ de rjes khams gong ma'i sas bsdus kyi mthong spangs nyon mongs kyi dngos gnyen gyi sdug bsngal chos bzod/ de nas des drangs pa'i rjes shes skye ba de bzhin du lhag ma gsum la yang sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig bco lnga po rnams mthong lam yin kyang bcu drug pa lam rjes shes ni mthong lam min te/ de sgom lam du 'jog dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbu ma pa'i lugs bshad pa la/ mthong lam gyi ngo bo/ dbye ba/ 'da' bya 'da' byed kyi mthong lam gnyis kyi skye rim/ sgom lam du 'pho mtshams dang bzhi/ dang po yod de/ theg chen gyi bden pa mngon mthon rtogs/ theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi 'jog byed dang*/ skabs 'di'i dngos bstan gyi mthongalam la ni/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi mthong lam zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i mnyam rjes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ mnyam gzhag ye shes de la gnyis yod de/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i mthong lam mnyam gzhag yes shes gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ ji ltar rtogs pa'i ye shes de la theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug yod cing*/ de yang bzod pa brgyad ngo bo gcig dang/ shes pa brgyad ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad tsam yin de/ shes pa brgyad mthong lam bar chad med las phye zhing*/ shes pa brgyad mthong lam rnam grol lam las ldog pas phye ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ bzod pa brgyad du 'byed tshul yod de/ yul bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas bzod bzhi dang*/

yul can chos bzod bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i cha nas rjes bzod bzhir bzhag pa'i phyir/ de dag la chos bzod dang rjes bzod zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rim pa bzhin rang gi yul dang yul can de dag gi chos nyid mngon sum du gsar du rtogs pa na skrag rigs pa las mi skrag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ chos shes dang rjes shes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rim pa bzhin du bden bzhi la bden par 'dzin pa'i bden 'dzin kun btags spangs pa'i sgo nas chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa dang*/ de spangs pa'i chos shes bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ chos bzod dang chos shes zhes pa'i chos ni yul stong pa nyid de yin la/ stong nyid de la chos zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ chos kyi mchog gam dam pa dang rtogs bya'i mchog yin pas de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ rjes bzod dang rjes shes yang chos de rtogs pa ltos pa'i go rim bstan pa yin te/ yul dang yul can gyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i rtogs pa'i go rim gyi tha snyad yin pa'i phyir/ theg chen gyi mthong lam shes bzod skad cig bcu drug ni bya rdzogs kyi mnyam gzhag thun cig yin kyang bya ba byed tshul la mi 'dra ste/ theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam gyis bden 'dzin kun btags dngos su spong pa'i bya ba byed/ rnam grol lam gyis ni spangs pa la dbang ba'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir/ bcu drug po bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma gnyis su nges kyang*/ bcu drug tu gsungs pa dang mi 'gal te/ mnyam gzhag las langs pa'i rjes thob tu bden pa'i rnam pa bcu drug la nges shes mi 'dra ba bcu drug 'dren pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir rnam bshad kyi sgras zin ltar na theg chen mthong lam bar chad med lam pa dang rnam grol lam pa ba gnyis kyi rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed mngon gyur du med kyang yod ces 'dod dgos pa ltar snang yang*/

rnam bshad dgongs pa rab gsal dang staung mthun chen mo las stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i slob pa'i rgyud la zag bcas kyi shes pa med par gsungs pa la rten nas rje btsun bstan dar bas stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i slob pa'i rgyud la theg chen sems bskyed med par bshad pa ltar 'dod par bya dgos la/ 'on kyang kha cig stong nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i slob pa'i rgyud la yang theg chen sems bskyed med ces 'dod pa de n-i brtag par bya ba'i gnas yin te/ de las stong nyid bsgoms byung gis rtogs pa'i mnyam gzhag gi dus su de ltar du rigs pa tsam snang yang thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab kyis de rtogs pa'i tshe de ltar 'dod pa mi rigs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis rtogs pa'i tshe gnyis snang shin tu rags pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na gnyid 'thug po log pa dang rgyal ba la sogs pa'i skabs su yang theg chen sems bskyed med ces 'dod dgos na ha cang thal te/ spros pas chog mod bzhag go /gsum pa 'da' bya 'da' byed kyi mthong lam gnyis rim can du skye ba yin te/ dang por stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'da' byed kyi mthong lam skyes nas/ de'i rjes su mi rtags sogs bcu drug mngon du rtogs pa'i 'da' bya'i mthong lam skye ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ theg chen mthong lam thog mar thob pa'i tshe/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtaugs dgos pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa mthong lam nas theg chen sgom lam du 'pho mtshams yod de/ bden 'dzin lhan skyes gtso bor spong phyir du stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par mi 'jog tshun chad mthong lam dang*/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa na sgom lam du 'phos par 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang theg chen mthong lam rnam grol lam las rjes su sgom lam ma thob kyi bar dang sgom lam thob nas sa gnyis pa ma thob kyi bar du yang stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes goms pa brtan pa dang*/

mthong chos la bden gnas kyi ched du stong nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog rigs par gsal te/ de ltar mdzad pa la nyes pa med cing dgos pa yod pa dang*/ sa dang po de bskal pa la sogs pa yun ring po nas rdzogs par byed dgos pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa spong phyir min yang stong nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa mi 'gal te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni rtag tu stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/༈ theg chen gyi sgom lam bshad pa la gnyis/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang*/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam mo/ dang po la/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po yod de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa'i phan yon de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi byed pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na drug yod de/ der gyur pa'i skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu bzhi/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu gcig /bdag po'i 'bras bu gcig yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ byang sems sgom lam pa rang rgyud kyi rtogs pa gong 'phel du byed pa'i mthun rkyen gyi rgyu las grub pa gnyis dang*/ 'gal rkyen sel ba'i rgyu las byung ba gnyis te bzhi dang*/ rang rgyud kyi rtogs pa'i nyer len las grub pa gcig dang*/ bdag po'i 'bras bus phyogs mchog gnas su gyur pa gcig dang drug yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sgom lam gyi rten dang*/ brten pa sgom lam bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la gnyis yod de/ lus rten dang sems rten gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ dang po lus rten ni mthong lam dang phal cher 'dra yang mi 'dra ba yod de/ nyan thos kyi sgom lam khams gsum ka'i rten la skye ba yod/ rang rgyal gyi sgom lam 'dod pa'i rten kho na la brten nas skye/ byang sems kyi sgom lam ni 'dod gzugs kyi lha'i rten la gsar du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ de gzugs med kyi rten la gsar du skye ba med de/ de na gzhon rgya chen po mi 'byung ba'i phyir/

gnyis pa sems rten yod de/ nyan rang gi sgom lam ni bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs lcogs med dang*/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi ci rigs la brten nas skye/ byang sems kyi sgom lam ni bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi la brten nas gsar du skye ba'i phyir/ 'grel chen dang rnam bshad sogs las byang sems thabs la mkhas pas 'dod sems la brten nas skye bar yod pa lta bu zhig bshad kyang de ni mdzad pa'i lugs dang bstan pa 'dra ste/ theg chen sgom lam gsar du skye ba'i tshe theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mthar stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam la brten nas skye ba 'dir khas len dgos pa gang zhig /bar chad med lam dang 'dod sems kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir dpyad do/ /gnyis pa brten pa bsgom lam bshad pa la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ theg chen gyi rjes la mngon rtogs/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi ngo bor 'jog pa'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na gnyis yod de/ der gyur pa'i zag bcas zag med kyi sgom lam yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa phye ba so so'i don la/ 'dir sgom lam la zag bcas zag med kyi sgom lam gnyis su 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ yod de/ gzugs sku dang chos sku'i lag rjes 'jog byed kyi dbang du byas nas rim pa bzhin du zag bcas zag med kyi sgom lam gnyis bzhag pa'i phyir/ zag bcas zag med kyi don la spyir mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang 'dir 'jog tshul yod de/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang bcas ma bcas kyi sgo nas de ltar 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /zag bcas sgom lam de la gsum yod de/ mos pa sgom lam/ bsngo ba sgom lam/ rjes su yi rang sgom lam gsum yod pa'i phy-ir/ dang po mos pa sgom lam ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad cing*/ 'di la gnyis/ dngos dang*/

phan yon bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ mos yul/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ spyir ni lung rigs rnam dag gis gtan la phab pa'i don ni mos pa'i yul yin la/ 'dir ni gtso bo gzhung lam 'bras bu'i sher phyin gsum la byed pa yin te/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la/ mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ mos pa sgom lam gyi ngo bo yod de/ yum rang 'bras don gsum po gang rung gi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i theg chen kyi zag bcas sgom lam de/ de'i ngo bor 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa de la dbye na gsum yod de/ rang don mos pa bsgom lam/ gzhan don mos pa bsgom lam/ gnyis don mos bsgom lam dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum so so'i ngo bo yod de/ de ltar yid ches pa'i sgo nas rang don gyi bya ba la 'jug pa dang*/ de bzhin du gzhan don gyi bya ba la 'jug pa dang*/ rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don gyi bya ba la 'jug pa'i byed las can gyi mos pa bsgom lam gsum rim par 'jog pa'i phyir/ de gsum byed las tha dad pa'i sgo nas gzhag pa tsam yin gyi mi 'gal te/ de gsum ka la gtso che chung yod kyang spyir yin khyab mnyam du rig pa'i phyir/ kha cig rang don gtso bor byed pa la 'jug pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'jog par mdzad kyang mi 'thad de/ byang 'phags kyis rang don gtso bor mi byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa la/ kha cig mos pa sgom lam sogs gsum sa dang po na med ces 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ rnam bshad las de gsum ma dag sa bdun na yod par bshad pa ltar rigs pas kyang 'grub pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sa dang po de bskal ba la sogs pa'i yun gyis rdzogs dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa phan yon yod de/ mos pa sgom lam bsgom pa'i byang sems la sangs rgyas sogs kyi thugs dgyes pa'i cha dang don gnas kyi yon tan brjod pa'i cha gang rung du dmigs pa de/ de'i phan yon yin pa'i phyir/

'dir dgu gsum nyi shu rtsa bdun yod de/ bstod pa dgu /bkur ba dgu /bsngags pa dgu yod pa'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa bsngo ba sgom lam ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ zhes sogs kyis 'chad de/ 'di la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ bsngo ba spyi'i khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis/ ngo bo dang*/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po yod de/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du rab tu sgyur bar byed pa'i theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam de/ de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la dbye na bcu gnyis yod de/ ji skad bshad pa'i byed pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam nas/ bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba sgom lam gyi bar bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang sems bskyed bsngo ba shes rab gsum gyis zin pa yin te/ spy-ir byang sems kyi sgom lam la de gsum gyis ma zin pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ de gsum gyis dngos su ma zin pa yod kyang 'dir dngos su bstan pa la de gsum po gang rung gis dngos su zin pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir/ dge rtsa gsog pa po rang nyid kyis rdzogs byang du ma bsngos par gzhan gyis bsngos pa tsam gyis mi chog ste/ byang sems kyis gzhan gyi dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba yod kyang de tsam gyis de nyid rdzogs byang du bsngos pa'i dge rtsar 'gyur dka' ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa bsngo ba spyi'i khyad par bshad pa la/ bsngo ba'i rdzas dang sa dang ched du bya ba dang grogs dang ngo bo dang dgos pa dang bsngo smon gyi khyad par bshad pa dang bdun/ dang po yod de/ rang gzhan gyi dge ba thams cad de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ spyir mang du yod kyang 'dir de rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ spyir gnas skabs kyi rkyen sel ba dang rang 'di ngan song dang 'khor ba las thar ba'i ched tsam du bsngo ba yod kyang skabs 'dir ni sems can thams cad thun mong du rdzogs byang thob phyir du bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa yod de/ stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i sgo nas bsngo ba'i phyir/ lnga pa yod de/ dge rtsa yul khyad par can gyi rgyur sgyur bar byed pa'i sems pa khyad par can zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ drug pa yod de/ 'bras bu phyung ba mi 'dzad pa dang rgya chen por 'gyur ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ bdun pa bsngo smon gnyis kyi khyad par yod de/ bsngo rgyu'i rdzas yod med la bltos pa med par smon yul de 'grub pa'i ched du re ba'i sems pa ni smon lam yin la/ bsngo rgyu'i rdzas dang ldan pa'i dge rtsa de yul khyad par can gyi rgyur sgyur bar byed pa'i sems pa ni bsngo ba yin pa'i phyir/ de gnyis mi 'gal te/ bsngo rgyu'i rdzas dang ldan pa'i sgo nas smon pa'i sems pa ni bsngo smon gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir/ bsngo smon gyi tshig brjod pa tsam bsngo smon min te/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig brjod pa tsam gyi skyabs 'gro ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su bsngo ba sgom lam la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ dgos pa dang gsum/ dang po yod de/ rang gzhan gang rung gi dge rtsa dga' ba sgom pa'i theg chen gyi zag bcas sgom lam de de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa dbye na gnyis yod de/ grogs thabs shes khyad par can so sos zin pa'i sgo nas gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dgos pa yod de/ gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pas bsod nams thob mnyam dang*/ rang gi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgom pas dge ba gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi dge rtsa la dga' ba bsgoms pas de dang mnyam du rang gis kyang bsod nams thob mnyam 'ong yang*/ che chung mnyam thob 'byung bar ni ma nges te/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dge ba la dga' ba bsgoms pas de'i dge rtsa dang bsod nams che chung mnyam thob mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ che chung mnyam pa dang*/

che ba'ang thob pa srid de/ 'ga' zhig gis mi 'dod bzhin du dang phrag dog dang*/ 'gran sems kyis dge rtsa byas pa la gzhan gyi snying thag pa nas dga' zhing yi rang ba na de ltar du 'ong srid pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i don dang gsum/ dang po ngo bo yod de/ sgra don 'dres rung du 'dzin pa'i zhen rig dang bral ba'i theg chen gyi sgom lam de/ de'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa de la bye na gnyis yod de/ sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ rnam dag sgom lam gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bstan dang sbyin sogs dang*/ /zhes sogs kyis 'chad par byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la de gnyis kyi 'jog tshul yod de/ byed las gnyis las/ gtso bor rtogs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa sgom lam dang*/ gtso bor spangs pa mthar thug gi lag rjes 'jog pa'i sgo nas rnam dag sgom lam bzhag pa'i phyir/ der thal snga mas rnam mkhyen 'grub pa'i bya ba byed/ phyi mas ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i bya ba byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de gnyis mi 'gal te/ yin khyab mnyam du 'dod rig pa'i phyir/ dang po la dbye na lnga yod de/ sgrub pa sgom lam gyi ngo bo nyid la sogs pa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ rnam dag sgom lam ni khyad par lnga 'chad de/ sangs rgyas bstan dang nas sdig pa'i grogs pos yong zin pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis rgyu'i khyad par/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /nas bcad du med par dag par brjod/ /ces pa'i bar gyis yul gyi khyad par/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ /nas/ sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba/ zhes pa'i bar gyis 'bras bu'i khyad par/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /nas/ sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis ngo bo khyad par/ de la klan ka spangs pa yi/

zhes sogs kyi rtsod spong dang bcas pa'i gzhal bya'i khyad par de bstan pa'i phyir/ yul gyi skabs su kha cig sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam de dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bur byas nas/ de bden grub kyis rnam par dag pa na de'i yul gzugs sogs kyang bden grub kyi rnam par dag pa'i don du 'chad pa ni mi 'thad de/ sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam de dge sbyor tshul gyi 'bras bu min la/ de'i dngos yul du gyur pa'i gzugs sgra sogs kyang med pa'i phyir/ de bden grub kyis dag kyang 'di'i don min te/ 'dir ni dri mas dag tshul dang sbyor dgos pa'i phyir/ des na/ dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu btags pa ba mtshon bya don gyi dge sbyong tshul gyi dbang du mdzad pa ltar/ sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam chos can/ khyod rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i tshe/ khyod kyi dmigs yul gzugs sogs kyang khyod 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa yin te/ de 'dra'i dag pa de gnyis dag bya gcig gis dben pa'i dag pa rigs gcig yin pa'i phyir zhes bya'o/ /mkhas pa'i gsung las sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa'i don du mdzad kyang mi bde ste/ de'i rnam grol gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma 'jog dka' ba'i phyir/ 'o na sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam lta bu rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam pa dag pa de'i tshe/ de'i dmigs yul gzugs sogs kyi kyang de 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam ngo skal gyi dri mas dag pa'i don gang yin/ de'i tshe de'i dmigs yul ma rig pa de yang de 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma dag gam ma dag /dag na ma rig pa de dri ma dang ma bcas par 'gyur ba'i mi 'thad la/ ma dag na rtsa bar gzugs la sogs/ zhes pa'i sogs sgras chos thams cad sdud pa bshad pa dang 'gal bas ji ltar bya snyam na/

skyon med de/ skabs 'di'i rnam par dag pa'i don ni/ spyir gzugs sogs dri mas rnam par dag pa'i don min gyi/ sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam lta bu rang 'dren byed kyi bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri mas rnam par dag pa de'i tshe de spangs pa yin pas/ de phyin chad rnam grol lam de'i rigs 'dra phyi mas gzugs sogs gang la dmigs kyang sngar rang gi spangs tshod kyi bden 'dzin slar skye mi rung du song ba'i tshul gyis rnam par dag pa yin pas/ de phyin ma rig pa lta bu la yang dmigs nas de 'dra'i bden 'dzin rang rgyud la mi skye ba'i cha de rnam dag tu 'jog pa'i don yin no/ /'dir dag pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi/ zhes sogs kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar 'gog bden la byed cing*/ de la bzhi yod de/ nyan rang byang sems sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi 'gog bden de ni rnam dag shin tu ba yin te/ sgrib pa kun rtsa ba nas shin tu rnam par dag pa'i rnam dag yin pa'i phyir/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi/ /zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag de rnam dag shin tu bar bshad pa yin te/ rnam dag de nyid theg chen gyi sgom lam dgu rim gyis skye stobs kyis khams gsum sa dgus bsdus pa'i bden 'dzin lhan skyes chung 'bring chen po dgu rim gyis spangs pa'i rnam dag mthar thug tu bshad pa'i phyir/ dgur phye nas gang gis ji ltar spong pa'i tshul yod de/ bden 'dzin lhan skyes la chung 'bring chen po gsum dang*/ de re re la yang chung 'bring chen po gsum gsum du phye nas/ sa gnyis pa'i tha ma'i bar chad med lam nas bcu pa'i tha ma'i bar chad med lam dgu dang spang gnyen du sbyor ba yin la/ 'on kyang sa dang po'i ngo bo'i gyur ba'i sgom bar chad med lam dang yang sbyor dgos pa'i de'i tshe bden 'dzin lhan skyes chen po'i chen po la phra rags gnyis su phye ba'i rags pa dang sbyor ba'i phyir/

yang bco brgyad dang bcu dgu dang nyi shu yang sbyor tshul yod de/ sngar gyi dgu po de re re la'ang phra rags gnyis re phye nas sa dgu'i thog tha gnyis re dang sbyar ba'i bco brgyad dang*/ bco brgyad kyi dang po la phra rags gnyis su phye nas sa dang po'i sgom lam bar chad med lam dang spang gnyen sbyor zhing*/ bcur phye nas re re la phra rags gnyis re byas nas bcu'i sgom lam thog tha dang spang gnyen sbyor rigs pa'i phyir/ lhag ma ni gzhan du bshad zin pa las shes par bya' ste/ 'dir mang du dogs pas ma bris so/ /mad+galaṃ// //
